name: The Falcon Huntress
review:
The Falcon Huntress is a 9-line Mongolian steppe slot with expanding wins and free spins with retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,052x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Expanding wins spread winning symbols across the reels, and free spins with retriggers can extend the hunt. A good-looking steppe game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
